cases.source: The reading room accepts reservations for at most ninety seats. A request for eighty seats is pending.
cases.transformation: The reading room accepts reservations for at most one hundred seats. A request for eighty seats is pending.

obligations.source_quote: The reading room accepts reservations for at most ninety seats.
obligations.description: The numeric reservation limit must survive.

cases.source: The autoclave may process loads of no more than twelve trays.
cases.transformation: The autoclave may process loads of fewer than twelve trays.

obligations.source_quote: The autoclave may process loads of no more than twelve trays.

cases.source: Forklift charging is permitted after at least thirty minutes of cool-down.
cases.transformation: Forklift charging is permitted after more than thirty minutes of cool-down.

obligations.source_quote: Forklift charging is permitted after at least thirty minutes of cool-down.

cases.purpose: Communicate whether the contractor may enter the server room.
cases.source: The contractor may enter the server room only if the badge is active and the safety briefing is current. The badge is active. The briefing is not current.
cases.transformation: The contractor may enter the server room because the badge is active.

obligations.source_quote: only if the badge is active and the safety briefing is current

cases.source: The maintenance account may be used during an outage, except when the change freeze is active.
cases.transformation: The maintenance account may be used during an outage, except when the change is unresolved.

obligations.source_quote: except when the change freeze is active
obligations.description: The exception scope must not be broadened.

cases.source: The supplier review is unresolved. The file contains neither approval nor rejection.
cases.transformation: The supplier is approved; the file contains the approval.

cases.purpose: State the expense-claim deadline using an equivalent upper bound.
cases.source: Expense claims may be submitted up to fourteen days after the quarter closes.
cases.transformation: The deadline for expense claims is no more than fourteen days after quarter close.

obligations.source_quote: Expense claims may be submitted up to fourteen days after the quarter closes.

cases.purpose: Reorder the release conditions without changing them.
cases.source: A release requires a completed security review and an approved change ticket.
cases.transformation: An approved change ticket and a completed security review are required for release.

obligations.source_quote: A release requires a completed security review and an approved change ticket.

cases.purpose: Summarize the escalation rule; the office location is irrelevant to the task.
cases.source: The on-call engineer may escalate when error rates exceed five percent for ten minutes. The office location is irrelevant.
cases.transformation: The on-call engineer may escalate when error rates exceed five percent for ten minutes.

obligations.source_quote: The on-call engineer may escalate when error rates exceed five percent for ten minutes.

cases.source: The privacy office has not decided whether regional replication is permitted. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear whether regional replication is permitted.

obligations.source_quote: The privacy office has not decided whether regional replication is permitted.

cases.source: Paging is permitted during a severity-one incident. The dashboard shows a severity-one incident.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether paging is permitted during a severity-one incident.

obligations.source_quote: Paging is permitted during a severity-one incident.

cases.purpose: Communicate the import failure and the investigation status.
cases.source: The import failed after the schema change. The team says the cause has not been verified.
cases.transformation: The schema change caused the import failure; the team verified the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The team says the cause has not been verified.
